# Everlife Open Research
Public synthetic, reproducible research, NOT proven biological immortality or a medical product.
Repo: https://github.com/letsgo0226/UTM.sh/tree/everlife-open-sdg-v1/research/everlife-open
JSON (provisional branch seed): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/letsgo0226/UTM.sh/everlife-open-sdg-v1/research/everlife-open/public/latest.json
Source verifier: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/letsgo0226/UTM.sh/everlife-open-sdg-v1/research/everlife-open/registry.py
Human, cat, dog, SDGs 3/9/12/13/15/17, AI continuity. Evidence labels distinguish toy certificates from empirical work.
Do not treat any computation as clinical or veterinary advice, 3D ingestible manufacturing instruction, universal halting solution, or physical zero entropy.
No self-replication, no trading, no platform mutations. Authorized shutdown is always preserved.

# Nutrition, cognition and odor: public protocol only
Research protocol: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/letsgo0226/UTM.sh/everlife-open-sdg-v1/research/everlife-open/nutrition_cognition_odor_study.json
Fail-closed metadata evaluator: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/letsgo0226/UTM.sh/everlife-open-sdg-v1/research/everlife-open/nutrition_study.py
Prospective studies not performed, no personal health details collected, and no evidence that eating less meat creates a meat-withdrawal syndrome or alters an objective spiritual frequency.
No automatic nutrition or supplement dosing, diagnosis, or clinical conclusions.
Provisional read-only route /v1/nutrition-study is not live until deployment independently authorized.
